## Summary

Describe the change and its source-of-truth owner.

## Evidence

For political-data changes, identify the affected record and primary source. Explain any interpretation or unresolved uncertainty.

## Validation

- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate_source_privacy.py`
- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate_current_outputs.py`
- [ ] Quiz simulation run when quiz data or scoring changed
- [ ] Frontend consumer checked when public output contracts changed
- [ ] No credentials, identity numbers, private correspondence, or unsupported political claims added
